name: Office of the US Trade Representative (USTR)
bias_note: Official US government trade policy executive authority; legal instruments of record.

name: US Federal Register (Presidential Documents & Trade Rules)
bias_note: Definitive publication of executive orders, presidential proclamations, and regulatory implementation notices.

name: US International Trade Commission (HTS)
bias_note: Official statutory tariff schedules (HTSUS) and classification rulings.

name: US Customs & Border Protection (CSMS)
bias_note: Operational customs entry enforcement bulletins and duty collection directives.

name: EU Official Journal & TARIC Database
bias_note: Official European Commission trade regulations, retaliatory duty lists, and trade defense measures.

name: Canada Department of Finance (Trade Tariffs)
bias_note: Official Canadian retaliatory tariff gazette and order-in-council notices.

name: China Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM)
bias_note: State authority for Chinese customs duties, counter-sanctions, and unreliability lists.

name: World Trade Organization (I-TIP & Disputes)
bias_note: Multilateral trade agreement monitoring, dispute panel reports, and bound tariff rates.

name: United Nations Comtrade Database
bias_note: Global bilateral merchandise trade flow volumes and valuations reported by national customs.

name: IMF Direction of Trade Statistics (DOTS)
bias_note: Bilateral trade mirror datasets used for cross-checking customs misinvoicing and transit flows.

name: Reuters / Bloomberg / Financial Times
bias_note: Corroboration and fast notification of policy changes; secondary to official gazettes.

name: Atlantic Council Trump Tariff Tracker
bias_note: Policy think-tank tracker. Scaffolding cross-check only; items without legal instruments marked tracker-only.

name: Global Port Telemetry & Freight Indices
bias_note: Direct terminal operator throughput, dwell time, and vessel queue telemetry.

name: SCOTUSblog & CourtListener (Federal Litigation)
bias_note: Federal judicial decisions striking down or upholding presidential tariff proclamations.
